$comment: Website copy-pattern data pack for the vendored chwezi-slop detector (M10-11-T03). Source list: skills/quality-gates/design-quality-score/references/banned-patterns.md (decision-governed; slop-scan.sh reads it through this pack). Digital Research owns the machine-error and copy-slop doctrine (digital-research-engine/skills/anti-ai-slop/SKILL.md (ME1-ME7 and AS6)); this pack does not fork that content and carries only the website's own banned-patterns.md lists. Gradients, pure-black body text, bounce easing, fonts and layout families come from the design detector's registry, not from this pack. Validate with: node scripts/validate-slop-pack.mjs

authority.human_authority: Peter Bamuhigire, website-skills owner: decision-governed banned list in skills/quality-gates/design-quality-score/references/banned-patterns.md

rules.name: Unlinked 'Trusted by' logo row

authority.human_authority: Peter Bamuhigire, website-skills owner: decision-governed banned list in skills/quality-gates/design-quality-score/references/banned-patterns.md

params.message: 'Trusted by' or 'Featured in' followed by three or more logos with no link or proof before the section ends

exceptions: A row whose logos link to the case study or the publication passes. Star ratings from unnamed sources and stock team photos stay human_review.

rules.name: Standard curve used as the universal easing

authority.human_authority: Peter Bamuhigire, website-skills owner: decision-governed banned list in skills/quality-gates/design-quality-score/references/banned-patterns.md

params.message: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1): fine for one utility; check it is not the curve for every transition

exceptions: Only drift when applied everywhere; a reviewer decides. Bounce and elastic easing are the design detector's bounce-easing rule (block).
